title: jev usage's cost_usd still marshals an unset zero into decision records
body:
jev.Usage.CostUSD is a plain float64, so every classification decision record still carries "cost_usd": 0 that nothing ever measured — the root the tick's finding named. The status model now guards the reading (a price above zero is the only thing that meters), so no dashboard shows a fabricated $0.00, but a genuinely measured $0.00 from a future classifier answer is indistinguishable from the old fabricated shape and reads "not metered". Making the field a *float64 (null when the answering service stated no price) would stop the record fabricating a price and let a measured zero be represented honestly.
evidence: internal/jev/jev.go:181-186; internal/statusmodel/cost.go:96-104 (the guard's own comment names the choice); .ticfac/runs/run_ee8ebb4fe13d4311b8f9be6f66db69d4/decisions/1.json carries the shape
